title: Speed
summary: How fast is fast? Calculating speed, converting m/s and km/h, and average speed on real Indian journeys.

ib.note: Extended to velocity and acceleration in MYP 4

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 8: Measurement of Time and Motion (speed, uniform and non-uniform motion)

objectives: I can calculate speed using speed = distance ÷ time, and rearrange it to find distance or time.
I can convert between m/s and km/h.
I can distinguish uniform and non-uniform motion, and calculate average speed.
misconceptions: The object that travels furthest is always the fastest (time matters too).
Average speed is the average of the speeds.
A speedometer shows average speed (it shows instantaneous speed).
